Impact

Gestalt in the real world.

How museums and cultural institutions are using Gestalt to transform the visitor experience.

Philadelphia Museum of Art

The PMA piloted Gestalt across its impressionist galleries, offering audio descriptions to blind and low-vision visitors for the first time without requiring advance booking or specialized devices. Docents reported that sighted visitors began using the audio layer too, deepening their time in front of each work.

40% of visitors engaged with audio descriptions

Read case study →

The Barnes Foundation

The Barnes deployed Gestalt to deliver context-rich descriptions aligned with Dr. Barnes's original pedagogical approach — preserving his voice while making the collection accessible to visitors who have never been able to engage with its dense hanging arrangement. The integration required zero hardware changes to the galleries.

3× increase in dwell time among audio description users

Read case study →

City of Philadelphia Mural Arts Program

Mural Arts partnered with Gestalt to extend audio access to over 4,000 murals across Philadelphia's neighborhoods — a collection that exists entirely outdoors, without walls or labels. GPS anchoring and CLIP-based recognition allow visitors to point their phone at any mural and hear the artist's story in under a second.

4,000+ murals now accessible with audio descriptions
